title: Excavations at Sabratha 1948-1951
summary: Catalogue and discussion of the fine pottery from K. Kenyon's and J. B. Ward-Perkins' excavations at Sabratha from 1948-1951. An indispensable aid to all archaeologists working on classical Mediterranean sites, the catalogue of finewares sheds new light trade and distribution to and from Sabratha, as well as offering a useful catalogue from well-dated contexts.
